rules: get_point_index(r,c): x=sx*(c/width-1), y=sy*(r/height-1), z=data[r,c]*sz2; dedup by first visit
planar test abs((z00+z11)-(z01+z10)) < 1e-5; non-planar cell emits TL,TR,BR + TL,BR,BL
planar expand width then height via fits_plane (planar + same plane z_pred + same slopes); merged quad emits TL,TR,BR + TL,BR,BL
triangulation.precision_convention: pinned upstream numpy 2.5.4 (NEP 50): x=sx*f32(c/width-1), z=data*sz2 in f32; the 1e-5 threshold is itself converted to f32 (f32(1e-5)=9.999999747378752e-06 < 1e-5), so diff and threshold are both compared in f32; diff == f32(1e-5) is non-planar upstream; unit tests pin this boundary (QA O1 fixed)

slot_semantics.value: blob-local mesh index (hfield meshes appended after existing meshes; existing mesh indices unchanged)
slot_semantics.sentinel: u64::MAX for unreferenced/unused entries; empty -> 1 sentinel

slot_semantics.upload_representation: u32 low/high word pairs (little-endian) because TransferElement has no u64 impl and src/runtime is outside this card's file scope; ABI-equivalent to Array(U64)
